## Reviewed diagnostics / 已检查的诊断

Use `oc --json doctor ALIAS` where relevant. Do not publish credentials, complete configuration exports or signed URLs.

For vulnerabilities, use [private reporting](https://github.com/soulteary/oc/security/advisories/new); see [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/soulteary/oc/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
